description: While slide mode is active, the slide engine's highlighter has no built-in grammar for the `mermaid` fenced-code language. Instead of failing, a fenced code block tagged as `mermaid` is wrapped in a diagram container element (`<div class="mermaid">`) whose body is the HTML-escaped source code, so a downstream diagram plugin can render it. The input supplies Markdown containing a `mermaid` fenced block; output reports whether the diagram container marker is present.
